question: Among bounce (3rd down-day) events filtered to delivery-backed selling (deliv_x20>=1), does the subsequent 7-day return (ret7) grade well, i.e. does delivery-backed capitulation bounce better than the general bounce cohort? Expect higher ret7 for delivery-confirmed capitulation.
plain: Tests whether a 3-day-down oversold bounce works better when the selloff itself was delivery-backed (real selling/capitulation, not just churn).
